source_rules.rationale: Summarizes an arbitrary loop directly by addAccSpec and is present in verification.k before both Stage 1 proofs; no earlier proof against a module lacking this exact rule establishes it.
source_rules.text:
rule <k>
         #loop(list(intVals(INPUT:IntSeq)), Name("value"), addLoopBody)
         ~> (Return(Name("total")) .Stmts):Stmts
         ~> #endcall
       =>
         Return(addAccSpec(INPUT, false, 0))
         ~> #endcall
       ... </k>
       <env> L:Int </env>
       <scopes>
         ... L |-> scope(
           ("lst" |-> list(intVals(INPUT)))
           ("total" |-> 0)
           ("odd_index" |-> false)
           ("value" |-> 0),
           _:Parent)
         ...
       </scopes>
       [priority(30)]
